remoteAccess.pageSubtitle: Connect to this gateway from other devices. Pick one method — only one exposure mode should be active at a time.

tabIntro.guide: Compare options and see what's active on this gateway.
tabIntro.tailscale: Best for personal devices on your tailnet. Gateway stays on loopback; Tailscale Serve publishes HTTPS.
tabIntro.public: Create a Tunnel Registration Key in the Console and save it here, then start the tunnel for a public URL and pair your mobile app.
tabIntro.reverse-proxy: Front the gateway with your own HTTPS reverse proxy (Caddy / nginx / Cloudflare Tunnel) at a custom domain, then scan to pair your mobile app.
tabIntro.ssh: CLI SSH port forwarding when VPN or a public tunnel are unavailable.
tabIntro.lan: Reach the gateway on the same Wi‑Fi or LAN via its bind address, then scan to pair your mobile app.

guide.tailscaleCardDesc: HTTPS on your tailnet only. No public internet exposure.
guide.publicCardDesc: Share a public URL for mobile pairing and remote clients.
guide.reverseProxyCardDesc: Use your own HTTPS reverse proxy at a custom domain.
guide.sshCardDesc: CLI forwarding when VPN or public tunnel are unavailable.
guide.lanCardDesc: Use the gateway bind address on your local network.
guide.conflictsHint: Only one exposure method should be active. Disable the other before switching.
guide.oneAtATimeHint: Tailscale Serve and the public tunnel cannot run together. Use Overview to check status before switching.
guide.needToken: Sign in to the gateway (valid token) to manage remote access.

advanced.proxyBody: When the gateway sits behind nginx, Caddy, or another proxy, configure trusted headers and optional gateway.remote for CLI clients.

lan.title: Same network (LAN)
lan.subtitle: Reach the gateway from phones or laptops on the same Wi‑Fi without exposing it to the internet.
lan.body: Set the gateway bind address to your LAN IP (or 0.0.0.0) and connect using http://<host>:<port>. Keep firewall rules in mind.
lan.pairSubtitle: On the same Wi‑Fi, scan to connect your phone. The app exchanges a one-time pairing key for your gateway token.
lan.pairBlockedNextSteps: Or use the Public internet tab to pair through a tunnel.

tailscale.title: Tailscale Serve (recommended)
tailscale.subtitle: Expose the gateway on your tailnet over HTTPS while keeping the process bound to loopback.
tailscale.stepInstallAfter: on this machine and sign in to your tailnet.
tailscale.stepEnable: Enable Serve below to publish HTTPS on your tailnet hostname.
tailscale.stepCopy: Open or copy the HTTPS URL on any device on the same tailnet.
tailscale.hint: Requires Tailscale installed and logged in on this machine. API routes still require your gateway token.
tailscale.cliMissingIntro: Tailscale CLI not found on this machine.

ssh.title: SSH tunnel (CLI)
ssh.subtitle: Forward the remote gateway loopback port to your laptop when Tailscale is unavailable.
ssh.hint: Replace user@your-host with your SSH login. Run on the machine where you want to use the gateway console.

reverseProxy.title: Reverse proxy (self-hosted HTTPS)
reverseProxy.subtitle: Front the gateway with your own Caddy / nginx / Cloudflare Tunnel at a custom domain.
reverseProxy.urlHint: No trailing path. https required for public hostnames; http is only allowed for RFC1918 / .local.
reverseProxy.autoDetectedTitle: Detected from your current browser address
reverseProxy.autoDetectedHint: The QR below already uses this URL. Click "Save as default" to persist it so other machines see the same URL.
reverseProxy.certWarning: Mobile clients require a certificate trusted by the system root store (Let's Encrypt / Cloudflare / commercial CA). Self-signed certificates are not supported in v1.
reverseProxy.qrSubtitle: Scan from the xopc mobile app to pair through your reverse proxy.
reverseProxy.noUrlYet: Enter your reverse-proxy public URL above to generate the pairing QR.

probeStatus.code_AUTH_BLOCKED: Reverse proxy returned 401/403 — remove auth in front of /api/tunnel/pair/ping
probeStatus.code_NOT_XOPC_GATEWAY: URL did not identify as an xopc gateway
probeStatus.code_has_path: URL must not contain a path
probeStatus.code_has_query_or_fragment: URL must not contain query or fragment
